caption: The drawing depicts a single, round, brown object resembling a carved wooden stamp or mold placed slightly off-center on a plain, beige background. The object has an intricate, raised design on its face, featuring symmetrical patterns of leaf-like shapes and fern-like textures emanating from the center, and is bordered by a geometric triangular motif. The carved section appears to be a slightly lighter brown than the object's outer edge. A small cylindrical handle or projection is visible on the left side of the object, shaded to indicate three-dimensionality. The name "CHARLOTTE ANGUS" is written in small, uppercase, brown letters below and slightly to the right of the round object.
title: Pa. German Butter Mold
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
